messages:
eva_sales: Hey team — NewWave Finance dropped a full security questionnaire + CAIQ export. Can security triage and confirm which items need engineering? Link: https://drive.google.com/newwave-qna (answers requested by 2026-04-05). POC planned week of 2026-04-12. Key asks: data residency, BYOK/KMS, SOC2 evidence, pen test results, log retention.

matt_security: Got it. Assigning to leah_seceng for the technical pass. I'll create a tracking ticket.

security-bot: Ticket SR-4821 created for security-questionnaire intake (assignee: leah_seceng).

leah_seceng: On it. Quick clarifying Q: Will the POC use Hosted API or Dedicated/Private deployment? That changes how we answer data residency and BYOK.

eva_sales: POC is Dedicated (customer requested isolated GPUs + VPC). NDA is in place (Maya, can you confirm we can share SOC2?).

maya_salesops: Confirmed NDA exists. I'll pull SOC2 report access and DM legal if needed. SFDC has the case link.

jordan_solutions: FYI if Dedicated + BYOK required, pricing delta will apply — will flag to AE.

leah_seceng: Initial notes (short):
```
- Encryption at rest: AES-256
- KMS: support for customer-managed keys (BYOK) for Dedicated/Private via KMS/HSM
- Network: VPC peering + restricted egress available
- Audit logs: centralized, can be exported to customer SIEM
- Retention: default 30d, can support 90d for POC with agreement
```
I'll do a line-by-line response to the CAIQ. ETA: 48h for draft.

matt_security: Thanks. Also need explicit answers to two customer custom Qs: (A) Can logs be scrubbed of PII before export? (B) Is customer data allowed for model training? Need explicit yes/no + policy.

eva_sales: I'll ask NewWave and post back. cc @maya_salesops

security-bot: SR-4821 status -> In Progress (assignee: leah_seceng).

leah_seceng: Draft answers uploaded to Drive: https://drive.google.com/draft-newwave-qna. Added inline answers and highlighted items needing legal/SRE input. :eyes:

matt_security: Quick pass done. Left two inline comments about retention limits and redaction scope.

eva_sales: NewWave responded: logs must be scrubbed (PII redaction) and retained max 90 days. They explicitly DO NOT allow use of customer PII for model training. They also want SOC2 + recent pen test.

leah_seceng: Noted. I'll update final responses to reflect 90d retention and explicit no-training clause. Will attach SOC2 reference and pen test procedure note. ETA EOD tomorrow for final package.

matt_security: After finalization I will: 1) attach SOC2 report, 2) update SR-4821 -> Resolved, 3) push artifacts to SFDC case.

maya_salesops: FYI finance needs to know if security reqs add a managed-services delta. @jordan_solutions pls advise on estimate for POC.

jordan_solutions: Preliminary delta estimate: Dedicated + BYOK + extended retention/support ~= +25% MRR for short-term POC. I'll prepare a 1-pager and share by EOD.

eva_sales: Thanks all — I'll wait for the final doc and then send to NewWave. Marking thread for visibility. :white_check_mark:

security-bot: SR-4821 status -> Awaiting customer confirmation.
